top_signals.title: US Stocks Pare Gains as Jobs Data Seen Easing Fed Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: US stocks pared gains on Friday after jobs data showed the US economy unexpectedly shed jobs in July, which could prompt the Federal Reserve to delay interest-rate increases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
